acquisition_method.evidence: MS/MS was triggered by the DDA module with the top 10 precursors isolated by a 2.0 m/z window.
For PRM analysis, samples were re-injected into LC−MS with the same setting.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Trypsin digested peptides were first dissolved in 150 μL 80% acetonitrile containing 5% trifluoroacetyl (TFA) and loaded onto TiO2 microcolumns (GL Sciences).

collision_energy.evidence: HCD was used to fragment peptides with NCE at 27 and resolution at 17,500.

fragmentation_method.evidence: HCD was used to fragment peptides with NCE at 27 and resolution at 17,500.

instrument.evidence: The MS analysis was performed by Q-Exactive Plus.
